description: Flood zone at the exact point. US: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer zone (A, AE, V and so on mean high risk, where lenders usually require flood insurance; shaded X moderate). England: Environment Agency Flood Zone 1, 2 or 3 from rivers and the sea. Wales, Scotland and NI: a link to their own flood map. Returns a plain listing line and the official checker link.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).
